title: No synchronous remote call between venue event and local order
statement: No synchronous call to Fabric, warm services, Spanner, Bigtable, Redis, BigQuery, AI or another region is required between a venue event and a local order.
rationale: Any remote call on that path makes a remote outage a trading outage and a remote latency a trading latency.

verification.check: With every remote dependency stalled, a venue event still produces an order in bounded time; inserting a blocking remote call before the pass fails.

title: All internal async contracts use the Rust Fabric SDK and schema model
statement: All internal asynchronous contracts use the Rust Fabric SDK/schema model (with Pub/Sub and Managed Kafka absent from core internal messaging).
rationale: Two messaging systems mean two sets of semantics and two places a record can be lost.

verification.check: Every cross-process async contract is a declared Fabric stream; no other transport carries one.

title: Broker/zone failure loses no quorum-acked records and does not stop Reflex
statement: A Fabric broker or zone can fail without losing quorum-acknowledged P0/P1/P2 records or stopping Reflex execution.
rationale: Losing acknowledged outcomes is losing financial truth.

verification.check: Kill a broker after ack; all acked records readable; Reflex passes continue.

title: Every financial outcome commits exactly once in effect via event-id idempotency
statement: Every financial outcome is eventually committed exactly once in effect to the authoritative ledger through event-id idempotency, even when delivered multiple times.
rationale: Double-booked or dropped outcomes corrupt capital.

verification.check: Property test: any redelivery/crash schedule yields single-delivery balances.

title: Every Reflex model/policy traces to commit, manifest, signature, approval and epoch
statement: Every model/policy executing in Reflex can be traced to its source commit, data/evaluation manifest, signature, approval/promotion event and activation epoch.
rationale: An untraceable model in production cannot be explained after an incident.

verification.check: The activated package record carries all five links; removing one is refused.

title: Region loss does not halt healthy regions
statement: Region loss does not globally halt healthy regions; cross-region cycles that depend on failed peers are disabled explicitly.
rationale: A global halt on one region's failure multiplies the outage.

verification.check: Darkening one region leaves other cells' home trading unchanged and suspends only mirrored legs into it.

title: Production workloads reconciled from Git and admitted only under supply-chain policy
statement: Production workloads are reconciled from Git and admitted only when supply-chain policy is satisfied.
rationale: A workload deployed around Git or admission is unreviewed code in production.

verification.check: Every Run service is a GitOps manifest pinned by digest and subject to BinAuthz.

notes: Blueprint says GKE; under ADR 0024 the workloads are Cloud Run services reconciled by Config Connector.

title: Autonomous agents cannot gain capital authority, bypass policy or hold long-lived keys
statement: Autonomous agents cannot obtain production capital/custody authority, cannot merge/deploy around policy, and cannot access long-lived cloud keys.
rationale: An agent with authority is an unaccountable trader.

verification.check: Autonomy changes require an authenticated operator identity; no SA keys exist; prod deploy refused from workflows.

title: Replay reconstructs history from Fabric/GCS to test strategies and explain incidents
statement: Replay can reconstruct market/decision/outcome history from Fabric/GCS sufficiently to test a strategy/model and explain a live incident.
rationale: An incident that cannot be replayed cannot be explained.

verification.check: Replaying a recorded session reproduces every event, book, fill and flag.

title: Reconciliation rebuilds positions and cash from ledger plus venue/custody statements
statement: Reconciliation rebuilds and verifies positions and cash from the authoritative ledger plus venue/custody statements without trusting caches.
rationale: Positions trusted from a cache drift from reality unnoticed.

verification.check: Refolding the outcome stream equals stored balances; venue drop-copy reconciles; breaks are counted by direction.

title: Every critical component is exercised in scheduled game days with RTO/RPO
statement: Every critical component is exercised in scheduled game days and has observable RTO/RPO or a documented reason exact guarantees cannot be promised.
rationale: Recovery objectives never measured are guesses.

verification.check: A schedule and per-component RTO/RPO measurements exist.

title: Every material forecast carries horizon, distribution, calibration, disagreement, lineage and expiry
statement: Every material forecast has a horizon, probability distribution, calibration score, model disagreement, evidence lineage and expiry.
rationale: A forecast missing any of these cannot be scored or trusted.

verification.check: The forecast type refuses construction without each field.

title: Model influence is earned from resolved performance; no permanent authority
statement: Model influence is earned from resolved forecast performance by domain/regime, and no single frontier model is a permanent authority.
rationale: A permanent authority model is a single point of epistemic failure.

verification.check: Weights move with resolved scores per regime; a model with poor scores loses weight.

title: Meta-Intelligence explains budget allocation and measures marginal information value
statement: Meta-Intelligence can explain why compute/agent budget was allocated to a question and measure marginal information value afterward.
rationale: Budget allocation nobody can explain cannot be improved.

verification.check: Each allocation records a rationale and a post-hoc information value.

title: Accelerator/QPU use selected by measured fit; promotion never depends on unverified quantum advantage
statement: TPU/GPU/QPU use is selected by measured workload fit; classical baselines remain reproducible and promotion cannot depend on unverified quantum advantage.
rationale: "We used a quantum computer" is not a result.

verification.check: Promotion refuses a quantum-produced candidate and a quantum-informed one without a calibrated classical baseline.

title: Twin and synthetic jobs can fail without affecting live trading
statement: Digital-twin and synthetic-world jobs can fail or backlog without affecting live trading.
rationale: A simulator on the trading path makes simulation load a trading risk.

verification.check: Edge node links no twin/simulation crate.

title: Capital/Hedge/Confidence can reduce or veto exposure independently of alpha
statement: Capital, Hedge and Confidence services can reduce or veto strategy exposure independently of forecast/alpha services.
rationale: A veto that depends on the alpha service agreeing is no veto.

verification.check: A risk limit vetoes a proposal regardless of signal strength.

title: No superintelligence service is a synchronous dependency between tick and order
statement: No agent, world model, forecast service, TPU job or QPU workflow becomes a synchronous dependency between tick and order.
rationale: Cognition on the order path makes the slowest model the latency floor.

verification.check: Edge node depends on no cognitive crate and trades identically with the centre silent.

title: Fabric must not sit in front of venue data or order submission
statement: The Rust Fabric must not be placed in front of venue market data or order submission; the hot path bypasses it.
rationale: Fabric latency and outages would reach every order.

verification.check: Feed and gateway are bound in the node without a Fabric hop; a code-level guard fails if the node reads market data from a Fabric consumer.

title: Must not rebuild Kafka semantics blindly; prove required semantics
statement: The Fabric implements only Algorik-required semantics and proves them with fault/property tests rather than rebuilding Kafka semantics blindly.
rationale: Unproven semantics are assumed semantics.

verification.check: Each declared semantic has a fault/property test that drives the code.

title: Must not claim global exactly-once delivery
statement: No component claims global exactly-once delivery; transport is at-least-once with idempotent state transitions and fencing.
rationale: An exactly-once claim invites consumers to skip idempotency.

verification.check: Source scan finds no exactly-once claim; consumers dedup; producers fenced by epoch.

title: Must not share one Spanner database across trust domains
statement: Ledger, world graph, agent memory and service tables must not share one Spanner database; trust/performance domains are separated.
rationale: Analytical load on the ledger database degrades money truth.

verification.check: Each Spanner database serves one domain; a second domain's tables in the ledger DB fail.

title: Must not use Redis as position/capital truth or a risk-gate dependency
statement: Redis must not be position/capital truth or a required dependency of any risk gate.
rationale: A cache failover would erase positions or open the risk gate.

verification.check: Risk gate crates cannot reach the Redis client; composition roots refuse a cache as store of record.

title: Must not use one global GKE cluster or one flat VPC
statement: The platform must not run a single global GKE cluster or a single giant flat VPC.
rationale: One cluster or one network is one blast radius.

verification.check: Multiple VPCs per environment; any cluster is regional and not shared across regions.

title: Reflex traffic must not traverse mesh, proxy, SWP, NAT chains or gateways without benchmarks
statement: Reflex traffic must not be routed through a service mesh, proxy, Secure Web Proxy, Cloud NAT chain or general API gateway without benchmarked necessity.
rationale: Each hop adds latency and a failure domain to every order.

verification.check: Execution node has no LB/mesh/proxy hop; any NAT on its venue path is backed by a recorded benchmark.

title: AI agents must not change production by kubectl, SSH or console
statement: An AI agent must not change production via kubectl/SSH or console clicks; only GitOps or a pre-approved audited runbook.
rationale: Imperative agent changes are unreviewed and unreconstructable.

verification.check: No agent identity holds production write/SSH/kubectl grants; shells only via IAP.

title: Must not promote models without replay, calibration, baseline and risk-envelope tests
statement: No model is promoted without replay, calibration, classical-baseline and deterministic risk-envelope compatibility tests.
rationale: A model promoted on a backtest alone is unverified against the controls it must live within.

verification.check: Promotion refuses a candidate missing any of the four.

title: Must not use mutable tags, unversioned schemas, hand-copied models or undocumented emergency config
statement: No mutable 'latest' tags, unversioned schemas, hand-copied model files, or undocumented emergency configuration.
rationale: Each makes what ran unreconstructable.

verification.check: Every image pinned by digest; registry tags immutable; schemas versioned and locked.

title: Observability must not block execution or emit raw tick rate into logs
statement: Observability must not block execution and must not emit raw tick-rate events into general-purpose log ingestion.
rationale: A logging stall or a tick-rate log bill becomes a trading incident.

verification.check: Per-event lines are rate-bounded; metrics recording is in-memory; a slow scrape does not delay a pass.

title: Machine selection is validated by venue-level benchmarks
statement: Exact Reflex machine selection is made by venue-level benchmark testing, not by catalogue specs.
rationale: Specs do not predict tail latency on a given venue.

verification.check: A benchmark record per venue/machine shape justifies the chosen type.

title: Bigtable app profiles match consistency needs
statement: Bigtable routing/app-profile choice matches each reader/writer's consistency needs.
rationale: Multi-cluster routing on a read-your-writes path returns stale data.

verification.check: An app profile per access pattern with matching routing.

title: Config Sync owns baseline/policy; Argo CD/Kargo own apps and promotion
statement: Config Sync owns baseline/policy reconciliation and drift prevention, while Argo CD/Kargo own applications and promotion.
rationale: Two reconcilers fighting over the same objects cause drift loops.

verification.check: Baseline manifests are reconciled by Config Sync; apps by Argo CD; no object owned by both.

title: QPU is used through a hybrid router and benchmark harness, never as an oracle
statement: QPU access goes through a hybrid compute router and benchmark harness coordinating CPU/GPU/QPU, never as a standalone oracle.
rationale: A QPU result trusted alone has no baseline to be wrong against.

verification.check: Every QPU result is benchmarked against a classical result before use.
